headline: Opt-in SPKI certificate pinning
summary: Adds a `pinnedServerSpki` config option that pins the server's SPKI hash on top of the existing PQC-mTLS posture. With pinning enabled, a CA compromise that issues a rogue cert for the configured server host is detected before the TLS handshake completes.

items.title: `pinnedServerSpki` config option
items.body: Operators can pin the SHA-256 of the server's SubjectPublicKeyInfo by setting `pinnedServerSpki` in `config.json`. On every outbound HTTPS / WebSocket connection the client computes the SPKI hash of the presented leaf cert and refuses the connection if it doesn't match the pin. Compatible with the PQC-mTLS handshake unchanged; the pin is checked after the regular CA validation passes. Set the value to the empty string or omit it to keep the existing CA-validation-only behavior.
